title: The convergent stack
summary: Inspired by Simpson's de Rham stack and Drinfeld's crystalline stack, we develop a stacky approach to convergent cohomology and convergent isocrystals in positive characteristic. To any scheme $X$ over $\mathbb{F}_p$ we attach a convergent stack $X_{\mathrm{conv}}$. When $X$ is of finite type over a perfect field, its finitely generated quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}[\tfrac1p]$-modules are equivalent to convergent isocrystals over $X$, compatibly with cohomology.
